title: Reference Manifest Schema
description: Shape of generated shortlist manifests consumed by skills. Produced by CI; placed in references/generated/<branch>/.

branch.description: Platform branch inside the skill, e.g. 'pingone-mt', 'ping-software/pingfederate'

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when manifest was generated

docs.description: Ranked list of candidate docs. Order = descending relevance score.

score.description: Relevance score (0–1). Based on canonical flag, recency, task-completion value, link popularity.

stale_warning.description: True if last_updated is older than 180 days
